claim: The confocal combiner's lines are reachable only as blanking, on digital lines through the acquisition software's line-select group. Per-line power is deliberately not transmitted: the vendor does not document the word format the power interface expects, and the transport was left complete but disabled rather than guessing a byte into a laser driver.
validity_conditions: Ruled TRANSFER under 10.2.1 and passed 10.3 rule 1, so it caps at E3 -- a run taken in another project is not a run taken here. 10.2's hardware-control-path row is open and says in its own rule that it does not wait for envelope/, because wrapping a control path needs no safety limit. Slot: A4, which screens on automatable, and the orchestrator. It is a refusal that was made on purpose and is worth carrying as such -- an undocumented control word is not a gap in the implementation to be closed by trying values. This store already recorded the combiner's power as write-only and uncalibrated; what is added is WHY it is not driven, which is the part that stops someone finishing the job.
